newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street stocks expected to head lower.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street stocks expected to head lower.

text.p: Wall Street stocks are expected to head lower at the start of trading Monday, taking their cue from the bond market.

Wall Street will shift its focus away from earnings and towards a slew of economic data today, looking for insight as to what action the Federal Reserve will take on interest rates at the May 20 meeting of its policy-makers.

The first of this week's data are due out today at 1000 EDT/1400 GMT -- March new home sales. The number is expected to drop to 794,000 from the previous month's 811,000, according to a Reuters survey of U.S. economists.
